quote: AI is in my workflow. It is not in charge of it.
witLine: // not a vibe coder. not even close.

points.title: I use it where leverage is real
points.description: Scaffolding, repetitive transformations, spec-to-component translation, test ideas, documentation passes. I use AI where speed compounds without lowering standards.

points.title: I do not outsource judgment
points.description: Architecture, edge-case behavior, permission logic, data contracts, naming, and the final shipping decision stay with me. That is the work.

points.title: I use it to stay in flow
points.description: The best AI use is not flashy. It removes drag. It helps me move through implementation faster so I can spend more attention on the parts that actually require engineering judgment.

points.title: I know when not to use it
points.description: If a piece of logic is security-sensitive, failure-prone, or subtle enough that generated code would blur understanding, I write it myself. Fast is only useful when it stays clear.
